sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: jungleland.it: the script now also runs on the jungleland.it bootleg artwork list (html/list.htm), off by default. Switch it on under ⚙️ Settings → 🌴 JUNGLELAND.IT. The Bootlegs button turns the long list into one filterable, sortable table with Title, Date and Year columns. The date the site appends to each title becomes its own column, and the titles link to each bootleg's artwork page in a new tab. It works on list.htm opened in its own tab; inside the site's two-frame view the narrow list frame is left as it is.
springsteenlyrics.com: no visible change. The plain table look is now shared with jungleland.it.
